I am a PhD student at École Normale Supérieure – Paris Sciences et Lettres University.

I am a computational sociologist studying how social behavior vary across societies.

I use large-scale data to understand how individuals differ in seeing themselves as independent or as part of a group, and how these differences shape social networks and broader social patterns. I focus in particular on variation across East Asia and Western Europe.
